findings.actualNativeImageObservation: Two clearly separated teal domestic-production and coral export-route clouds. A factory/workers/gear/boxes represents domestic production; a container ship/port/trading handshake represents export sales. Beneath each, parallel large people, inputs, coins and warning icons support common conditions. The central thinking person and outward-facing Bedingungen? placard connect both paths without declaring one winner.
findings.fachlicheCompatibilityWithNewDEENDescrip: The new bounded comparative assessment uses common criteria, mechanisms, conditions and limits. Parallel workforce/input/finance/risk motifs and the open condition question are compatible with that performance. The image does not assert autarky, guaranteed export income, universal prosperity or an always-better strategy. It is a conceptual orientation, not a fully worked development-policy appraisal or evidence of mastery.
findings.actual360pxObservation: At the actual360×203 raster display the factory, port/ship, central reflection and large Binnenproduktion/Export/Bedingungen? labels remain identifiable. The repeated people/input/coins/warning icons remain distinguishable. Smaller detailed captions, the mug slogan and book-spine words are not comfortably readable; they are supplementary and no required calculation, unique fact or policy rule depends on them. The main conceptual comparison can be recognized without reading this small print.
findings.actual680pxObservation: At the actual680×383 display both route scenes and the four parallel condition groups are clear. Their captions can largely be read; the overview still does not need tiny mug/book details. No crop occurs, and the28rem height cap does not reduce this near16:9 image.
findings.personPerspective: The conditions placard on the front edge faces the outside viewer as a public conceptual annotation, not as the thinker’s working notebook. The factory exterior sign and ship-side inscription are object labels; no personal exercise sheet, measurement display or board is incorrectly turned toward the viewer. The export handshake and factory handling are plausible cartoon actions.
findings.styleAndDensity: Friendly abstract comic figures, warm ivory background, rounded dark outlines and restrained teal/coral/gold match the existing consumer image and declared economics image landscape. The composition has several condition icons but the main two routes and central thought remain distinct at360. No photorealism, sterile technical replacement, visible technical identifier, provider watermark, brand or copied worksheet is seen.
findings.altTextAssessment: Existing alt text accurately identifies domestic production versus export routes, skills/inputs/finance/risks and open conditions; the new description adds no conflicting depicted claim. Preserve the link and alt text.
findings.recordedMinorLimitationNotBlocker: Supplementary labels become small at phone width; no required tiny content and no demonstrated misleading visual implication. This is no reason to replace a good existing image.
